title: 9-cis-Retinoic Acid Improves Disease Modelling in iPSC-Derived Liver Organoids
comparison_or_design: Archived iPSC-derived hepatocyte preparations versus HepaRG references.
time_scope: The collection stage of the registered iHEP_P2/HepaRG comparison; do not equate a title suffix with differentiation day or assume a Day-21 mapping without explicit support.
excluded: Earlier iPSC/iHepatocyte differentiation points and primary human hepatocyte reference samples
Stellate-cell, 9CRA, fibrosis, mixed-organoid and independent functional assays
population_or_material: The source-registered iHEP_P2 preparations and HepaRG reference preparations in GSE292959; exclude iHSC stellate-cell preparations.
